verdict.rationale: Kick supports automation that acts across many items indirectly — Rules apply logic to every matching transaction as it syncs (kick-docs-7, kick-docs-18), and MCP/CLI tools let an AI query transactions, generate reports, and 'execute bookkeeping changes' or 'automate month-end checks' across a workspace (kick-docs-15, kick-docs-24, kick-docs-26). This is closer to rule-driven automation than an explicit bulk-select-and-update operation across many items in a single action. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk-edit/batch-update UI or API (e.g., select N transactions and apply a change at once), and independent evidence of large-scale batch runs via MCP/CLI.
